abstract: BACKGROUND: Germ-cell tumors (GCT) are a histologically and biologically diverse group of neoplasms which primarily occur in the gonads but also develop at different extragonadal sites in the midline of the body. The head and neck region including the upper respiratory tract is a very rare location for such tumors in both children and adults, which can cause diagnostic and therapeutic difficulties. METHODS: We describe here two new cases of multilineage tumors including sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma [SNTCS], and congenital oronasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus) and compare their features with those of a new case of a rare salivary gland anlage tumor [SGAT], an entity for which the pathogenesis is unclear (i.e. hamartoma versus neoplasm). We correlate their presenting clinico-pathological features and compare histologic and cytogenetic features in an attempt to elucidate their pathogenesis and biologic potentials. RESULTS AND DISCUSSION: Cytogenetic analysis revealed chromosomal abnormalities only in the case of SNTCS that showed trisomy 12 and 1p deletion. Both cytogenetic abnormalities are characteristically present in malignant germ cell tumors providing for the first time evidence that this rare tumor type indeed might represent a variant of a germ cell neoplasm. The SGAT and epignathus carried no such cytogenetic abnormalities, in keeping with their limited and benign biologic potential. CONCLUSION: The comparison of these three cases should serve to emphasize the diversity of multilineage tumors (hamartomas and GCT) of the upper respiratory tract in regards to their biology, age of presentation and clinical outcomes. Malignant tumors of germ cell origins are more likely to affect adults with insidious symptom development, while benign tumors can nevertheless cause dramatic clinical symptoms which, under certain circumstances, can be fatal.
abstract_ja: 背景：胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）は組織学的・生物学的に多様な腫瘍群で、主に性腺に発生するが、正中線上の様々な性腺外部位にも生じる。頭頸部（上気道を含む）は小児でも成人でも極めてまれな発生部位であり、診断と治療に困難をきたすことがある。方法：副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫（SNTCS）および先天性口腔鼻咽頭奇形腫（エピグナサス）を含む多系統腫瘍の2新規症例を記載し、まれな唾液腺原基腫瘍（SGAT）の新規症例と臨床病理学的特徴を比較した。SGATは病因が不明で、過誤腫か新生物かについて議論がある。組織学的および細胞遺伝学的特徴を比較し、病因と生物学的潜在能力を明らかにすることを試みた。結果と考察：細胞遺伝学的解析で染色体異常が認められたのはSNTCS症例のみで、トリソミー12と1p欠失を示した。両異常は悪性胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的にみられるもので、この稀な腫瘍型が胚細胞腫瘍の一亜型である可能性を初めて示す証拠となった。SGATとエピグナサスにはこのような異常はなく、その限られた良性の生物学的特性と一致した。結論：3症例の比較は、上気道の多系統腫瘍（過誤腫およびGCT）について、生物学的特性、発症年齢、臨床転帰の多様性を強調するものである。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は症状の進行が緩徐な成人に多い一方、良性腫瘍でも劇的な臨床症状を引き起こし、状況によっては致死的となりうる。
